outputs.explanation: Panel A is a representative western blot image, not a plot of averaged data, so individual data points are not applicable.
Panel B shows representative phase contrast micrographs, not a quantitative plot of averaged data.
The bar chart in panel C (bottom) displaying mean ± SEM percentages also overlays individual data points (distinct symbols for each of the n=3 replicates) for every bar.
The bar chart in panel D (bottom) shows mean ± SD with individual data points (dots) plotted for each of the three replicates on every bar.
The heatmap displays each of the three biological replicates as separate rows per condition, so individual replicate values are already shown rather than only an average.
Panel F is a representative western blot image, not a plot of averaged data.
Both RT-qPCR bar charts in panel G show mean ± SEM with individual data points (distinct symbols) overlaid for each of the three replicates per bar.
Panel H shows representative immunofluorescence images, not a plot of averaged quantitative data.
